tweetText: The Oscars have ruled that AI-generated actors and scripts can't be nominated for awards. This decision highlights the industry's commitment to human creativity in film. via TechCrunch AI

AI dictation apps have been tested and ranked, showing their effectiveness for tasks like emailing, note-taking, and coding by voice. This highlights how AI can enhance productivity and streamline workflows. via TechCrunch AI
Disneyland has started using face recognition technology on its visitors. This raises concerns about privacy and surveillance at popular attractions. via WIRED AI
